claims.statement: Root AGENTS.md is the checkout entrypoint router: it holds behavioral contract sections 0-8 (non-negotiables, simplicity, surgical diffs, goal-driven execution) plus three managed blocks OPENWIKI:START/END, AKSK:ROUTING, AKSK:LIFECYCLE and delegates durable guidance to .agents/AGENTS.md and openwiki/index.md.

.agents/AGENTS.md is the portable prescriptive knowledge-layer file that must stay small and carries three sections: routing directives, project learnings, and self-improvement loop summary, working standalone in consumer installs.

Upon startup agents MUST read both .agents/AGENTS.md and openwiki/index.md before executing any file modifications; when exploring knowledge they start from openwiki/index.md and the decisions/troubleshooting directory indexes.

openwiki/index.md is a generated JIT catalog owned by OpenWiki tooling and never hand-edited, while openwiki/overview.md is a curated entry point indexing decisions and troubleshooting trees preserved across update runs under the AKSK curation contract.

Root AGENTS.md zoning order is FerroxLabs baseline (AKSK:AGENTS-BASELINE) → OpenWiki (OPENWIKI:START/END) → AKSK routing (AKSK:ROUTING) → AKSK lifecycle (AKSK:LIFECYCLE); in this repo baseline sections 0-8 are hand-authored inline without markers — the pre-seed state before init_agents_md.mjs vendors the baseline zone.

attach_section.mjs is the sole writer for AKSK:ROUTING and AKSK:LIFECYCLE blocks: it reads markers from the template at runtime via markersOf(), is idempotent and self-updating (trimmed compare then regex swap between markers), creates the target file if missing, and never touches content outside its marker pair.

CLAUDE.md demonstrates the thin-bootstrap routing pattern: its entire body is an OPENWIKI:START/END block linking to AGENTS.md rather than duplicating guidance, as required by the use-the-routing-pattern decision.

When debugging a failing test, build error, or runtime exception, the agent's FIRST action MUST be to search durable knowledge with grep -ri "<symptom>" openwiki/ .agents/ before debugging blind, mandated by both root AGENTS.md AKSK:ROUTING block and .agents/AGENTS.md routing directives.

Before architectural changes agents MUST search openwiki/decisions/ for recorded decisions to avoid violating established design patterns, and distillation must check openspec/specs/ so wiki pages never duplicate SHALL requirements.

OpenWiki concurrency guard requires checking test -f openwiki/.run.json before editing when openwiki may be active; editing mid-run leaves openwiki/.last-update.json with status interrupted and forces the next run to re-plan.

Bootstrap composition order is deterministic: bootstrap-global.mjs global lane (Node >=22, openspec/openwiki caret from references/versions.json via versionsFromPackageJson()) → aksk-init repo lane via bootstrap.mjs shim when present → OpenWiki tooling attaches OPENWIKI block → attach_section.mjs appends ROUTING then LIFECYCLE, each script idempotent so reruns only touch changed zones.

.github is listed as a bare pattern in .gitignore and .github/workflows is absent on disk, so any scheduled openwiki code --update workflow is not tracked and does not run on fresh clones; wiki updates happen via local openwiki --update or sync_wiki_indexes.mjs.

Consumer tool integrations under docs/integrations/ follow the same thin-router invariant: keep native files thin and point at .agents/; preferred path is EXECUTE lane via bootstrap.mjs handling routing-block and curation-contract attachment and per-agent spread, with per-tool guides as INSTRUCT manual fallback and without hardcoding skill paths.

Marker ownership is strict: content between any AKSK:* markers and OPENWIKI:START/END is owned by its writer and hand edits are corrected by rerunning the owning script; docs-lint enforces exactly one block per family, byte-intact routing/lifecycle, OPENWIKI presence-only, and baseline→OpenWiki→AKSK order.

openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md AKSK:WIKI-CONTRACT is attached by attach_wiki_contract.mjs: idempotent and self-updating (trimmed compare then regex swap between markers), never creates the file, fails fast with openwiki --init prerequisite if missing, and encodes preserve-and-link for curated trees, aksk_* frontmatter survival, and distill-authored pages bypassing the CLI via deterministic index sync.

sync_wiki_indexes.mjs deterministically rebuilds OpenWiki directory indexes without LLM or CLI run by driving the installed global openwiki package's okf/index-sync helper (docsOnly: true, virtualMode: true) via npm root -g lookup, failing closed when openwiki is missing or uninitialized.
